description: Read what one agent may do: its effective scopes with a description of each, how many approvals are pending for it, its rate limit and how idempotency keys work. Pass agent_id. Call it before a planned action to learn whether it will succeed instead of meeting a 403. An agent's own credential reads only its own agent; a workspace credential reads any agent in the workspace. Needs a Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

agent_id.description: The agent: its id, as it shows in your workspace. An agent's own credential can name only its own agent.

name: get_agent_capabilities
